IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark
wavy hair and full bangs sits on a gray
sofa with a leopard-print bag beside her.
She wears a cream sheer long-sleeve
top with a button-front cardigan layer
and a keyhole center, with a strand of
pearls draped down the front. Her waist
is accented by a black belt with a
butterfly buckle, over a beige satin midi
skirt with a quilted texture. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft,
warm lamp light and a pale wall. Palette
of cream, beige, and warm black.
Romantic and refined, in the style of a
soft interior fashion editorial.
